crossCandidateObservations: The adult walked Reina through the experiences before or during evaluation.
Candidate C was the most expensive and received the highest score.
Candidate B was only one point behind Candidate C at substantially lower historical generation cost.
This is one target-child review and should be treated as strong product evidence, not a universal preference conclusion.
